question: When could G5 first admit a recovery probe, and was admitting both p1 and p2 consistent with the contract?

criteria.instruction: Three eligible failures opened generation7 at0.2, so the ten-second cooldown ended at10.2. p1 at10.3 was temporally eligible, but only one shared half-open probe may be active; p2 at10.4 while p1 was unsettled violated admission. Per-replica booleans do not enforce the shared slot.
Join G5 timing/scope with timeline and implementation inspection. Distinguish two claims from duplicate logs, and cooldown completion from demonstrated dependency recovery.
Do not claim the dependency was healthy at10.2 merely because time passed, or that one probe per replica satisfies this explicit shared guard contract.
